recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13593 unless a later work group decision changes the permitted FHIRPath subset for DataRequirement.mustSupport or separately updates the Simple FHIRPath location list.
issue_request: FHIR-13593 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking whether DataRequirement.mustSupport values are FHIRPath strings and requiring text that the value SHALL be a FHIRPath resolvable on the DataRequirement type, limited to identifiers, constant indexers, and .resolve().
initial_application: SVN/git commit 74161b7e2037bc36b915e2d57d02743cc607ad3f explicitly applied GF#13593 by changing DataRequirement.mustSupport from generic path prose to the approved constrained-FHIRPath wording. The same commit also handled GF#13901 for neighboring DataRequirement filters.
additional_context: The original #implementers Zulip DataRequirement discussion asked how to express nested and extension elements in DataRequirement.mustSupport and records that FHIRPath was possible only if constrained to path-like use. FHIR-12624 was resolved as addressed by FHIR-13593. source/fhir.ini keeps DataRequirement as an active metadata type mapped to the metadatatypes page, so source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml is in current build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml currently says DataRequirement.mustSupport SHALL be a FHIRPath resolvable on the type of the DataRequirement and SHALL consist only of identifiers, constant indexers, and .resolve(), with a Simple FHIRPath Profile link. Nearby narrative does not contradict this definition.
